name: Rebecca Weinstein Bacon
tagline: Top rated Class Action & Mass Torts attorney in Chicago, Illinois
side_practice_areas: Class Action & Mass Torts, General Litigation, Products Liability
about: Rebecca Weinstein Bacon attended law school and graduated from Columbia Law School in 1997. Rebecca Bacon began practicing law in 1998.
Rebecca Bacon is an attorney at Bartlit Beck LLP, helping people with Class Action / Mass Torts: Defense issues. Bartlit Beck LLP has an office in Chicago, Illinois, serving the local community.

Rebecca Bacon was selected to Super Lawyers for 2013 - 2027. Super Lawyers is an exclusive list of top-rated attorneys in specific practice areas who were chosen after thorough evaluation of numerous criteria.
